name: Xbox 360 Racing Wheel v2
notes: 101-byte descriptor. Source: DJm00n/ControllersInfo xusb_wheel2. 16-bit wheel + 16-bit Z (combined accel/brake) + 10 buttons + hat. Routes through hidmaestro_xusb.inf XUSB companion (matches xbox-360-wired path). No xinputhid driver mode (would force 16-button gamepad layout, breaking subtype fidelity). The XInput subtype is 0x02 and the HID product string Wheel (XBOX 360 For Windows), the name Windows' xusb22 gives the HID device of a pad of that subtype (measured with xusb22 10.0.28000.3365). On the USB/IP backend xbox-360-wheel-v1 presents the same USB device: xusb22 takes its wheel layout from WheelPedalUsage in its Parameters key, which holds for the whole machine, never from the device (measured with xusb22 10.0.28000.3365), and no public source tells the two wheels apart.
